title: The Haunted Chamber: A Novel
author: Duchess
description: "The Haunted Chamber" by Duchess is a gothic romance novel written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story is set in an old castle, steeped in dark history and ghostly legends, focusing on the young baronet Sir Adrian Dynecourt as he prepares to host a gathering of guests at his ancestral home.

authorInfo.bio: Duchess (–1897) wrote The Haunted Chamber: A Novel. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
